subject: dsa
title: Add Two Numbers
summary: Add two numbers stored as reversed-digit linked lists.
problem: Two numbers are stored as linked lists, each node holding one digit in reverse order. Add them and return the sum as a list. Here l1 = 2 -> 4 -> 3 is 342 and l2 = 5 -> 6 -> 4 is 465.

steps.caption: Add 342 (2->4->3) and 465 (5->6->4). Digits are reversed, so add from the head with carry.
Ones place. 2 plus 5 is 7 with carry 0, so the first result digit is 7.
Tens place. 4 plus 6 is 10, so write 0 and carry 1.
Hundreds place. 3 plus 4 plus carry 1 is 8, with no carry left.
